title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 023 ]

blocks.text: For the past 25 years you have been a valued and respected employee of this company. Since you started in the mail room in 1979, your contributions to this firm have been invaluable. Your skills led to your being promoted to executive secretary in 1992. Thus, it is safe to say that without your contributions over the years, we would not be as successful as we have been. On behalf of all the executives, we wish you well and hope you enjoy your well-earned retirement.

readingSentences.english: For the past 25 years you have been a valued and respected employee of this company.
readingSentences.korean: 지난 25년 동안 귀하는 이 회사의 소중하고 존경받는 직원이었습니다.

readingSentences.english: Since you started in the mail room in 1979, your contributions to this firm have been invaluable.
readingSentences.korean: 1979년 우편실에서 일을 시작한 이래로 귀하가 이 회사에 한 공헌은 매우 귀중했습니다.

readingSentences.english: Your skills led to your being promoted to executive secretary in 1992.
readingSentences.korean: 귀하는 그 능력 덕분에 1992년에 임원 비서로 승진했습니다.

readingSentences.english: Thus, it is safe to say that without your contributions over the years, we would not be as successful as we have been.
readingSentences.korean: 그러므로 여러 해에 걸친 귀하의 공헌이 없었다면 우리가 지금만큼 성공하지 못했을 것이라고 말해도 좋을 것입니다.

readingSentences.english: On behalf of all the executives, we wish you well and hope you enjoy your well-earned retirement.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 임원을 대표하여 귀하의 행복을 빌며, 그동안의 노고로 얻은 은퇴 생활을 즐기시기를 바랍니다.
